AI/automation system for a construction & property maintenance business

I run a small construction/property maintenance business on the Gold Coast/Tweed called Revamp GC.

I'm building a private AI/automation system around the business. I already have a local Codex-built prototype started, but I'm looking for someone experienced to help improve the architecture, build practical automations and make it genuinely useful day to day.

The system is intended to help with:
organising emails, quote requests and work orders
linking jobs to Xero, Google Sheets and job history
preparing jobs before site visits
building a clear current-jobs dashboard
finding old job notes/chats/work logs from messy clues
capturing work logs for future pricing intelligence
review/approval workflows before anything is sent, changed or deleted

I'm not looking for a generic CRM setup. I need someone who can understand the direction, work with the existing prototype, and help turn it into a reliable operating system for the business.

Good fit if you understand AI workflows, APIs, n8n/Make or similar tools, local/private systems, business process automation, and practical implementation.

AI Automation Specialist for SEO, Social Media Ads & CRM Lead Generation

We are a small B2B company with a 4-person sales team. We are looking for an AI automation specialist to help us put our SEO and social media advertising largely on autopilot, and to feed better-qualified leads into our CRM.

WHAT WE NEED HELP WITH

1) SEO automation
- AI-assisted keyword research, content briefs, and on-page optimization
- A repeatable content workflow (drafting, internal linking, metadata, scheduling)
- Automated rank/traffic reporting we can review weekly without manual work
- A technical SEO audit and fixes so we start from a clean baseline

2) Social media advertising and organic
- Set up and run paid social campaigns (Meta and LinkedIn preferred)
- AI-assisted ad copy and creative variations plus a simple testing framework
- Automated content calendar and scheduled posting across our channels
- Retargeting and lookalike audience setup

3) CRM lead generation for our sales team
- Automated lead capture from our website, ads, and social directly into our CRM
- Lead enrichment, scoring, and routing so our 4 reps get the best leads first
- Automated follow-up sequences and task reminders for reps
- A simple dashboard showing lead source, lead quality, and conversion

TOOLS
We are open to recommendations (n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Clay, or similar). Please suggest the lowest-cost stack that will still do the job well. We are a small business on a tight budget, so ongoing software costs matter to us.

HOW WE WANT TO START
We would like to begin with a small paid pilot of roughly 10-20 hours: audit what we have, recommend a stack and priorities, and build one automation end to end. If that goes well, we will expand into the rest of the scope.

GoHighLevel Automation Expert Needed for Marketing Agency

We are a marketing agency looking for an experienced GoHighLevel automation specialist to help us build and refine several lead management and nurture automations inside our GHL account. This is a project-based position with the potential for additional work.

We are NOT looking for a copywriter. Our team will provide the email copy, SMS copy, landing pages, forms, and overall messaging. We need someone highly skilled in GoHighLevel to build the workflows, logic, segmentation, pipelines, tags, triggers, and follow-up systems.

What We Need Built

1. Direct Appointment Booking Automation — prospects who book a discovery call directly. Appointment confirmations, reminders, follow-up actions, pipeline organization, workflow logic.

2. Discovery Call Automation — what happens with a prospect before and after the call. Contacts segmented based on status and where they are in the sales process.

3. Online Audit Automation — a marketing audit prospects complete on our website. More advanced because prospects take several paths:
- start the audit but do not complete it
- complete the audit but do not qualify
- complete the audit, qualify, but do not book a call
- complete the audit, qualify, and book a call
Each group segmented, placed into the appropriate pipeline stage, enrolled in the correct follow-up or nurture sequence. As prospects take additional actions their status and automation should update. Contacts must not receive duplicate or conflicting messages.

4. Long-Term Nurture and Segmentation — qualified vs not-currently-qualified prospects receive different messaging and newsletters.

Existing GoHighLevel Snapshots — we have snapshots from a marketing program, but they need to be reviewed, modified and customized. We are not looking for someone who simply imports a snapshot and calls it done.

Must be comfortable with: GHL workflows and automation logic, If/Else conditions and branching, contact segmentation and tagging, pipelines and opportunities, appointment automations, workflow enrollment and removal, lead nurturing, email and SMS automations, custom fields, testing and troubleshooting.

We want someone who thinks strategically and recommends better structures, not someone who just clicks through the workflow builder.

To Apply: your GoHighLevel experience, screenshots of workflows/pipelines/automation logic you have built, an example of an advanced automation involving segmentation, branching logic, lead nurturing or multiple prospect paths, and your proposed fixed price.

We need a proper AI support agent built, not a basic FAQ bot. It should answer customer questions accurately from our own content, know when it doesn't know, and hand off cleanly to a human instead of guessing.

An AI agent that answers questions grounded strictly in our knowledge base (product info, FAQs, policies), so it only ever tells a customer something that's actually true for us. Error handling so failures alert us, and a short Loom walkthrough at handover.

We understand the hard part isn't the answers, it's the grounding and the handoff. If your proposal shows you get that, we want to talk.

Fixed-price project. Ongoing work as we expand it to more channels.

Expert Make.com Automation / API Integration Specialist — commercial real estate acquisition platform for Industrial Outdoor Storage (IOS) and industrial properties.

Architect and build a property-centric system connecting multiple SaaS platforms through Make.com, APIs and webhooks. This is not a basic Zapier or simple two-app automation project. I need someone capable of designing the underlying data architecture and building a reliable multichannel automation system.

Primary objective: Upload a targeted property list once -> enrich ownership/contact data -> automatically distribute the appropriate records to SMS, email and calling platforms -> identify interested property owners -> stop unnecessary outreach -> deliver qualified hand raisers into Close CRM.

Stack: Crexi Intelligence (property sourcing), Make.com (orchestration), BatchData (owner/contact enrichment), Close CRM (master property/deal CRM), Lead Sherpa (SMS), Smartlead (cold email), Kixie (power dialer), DocSend (deal room later). Architecture must remain modular so vendors can be replaced without rebuilding.

CRITICAL: ONE PROPERTY = ONE MASTER RECORD IN CLOSE. Every property receives a permanent unique Property ID, e.g. IOS-000001. One property may have multiple owners/decision makers, phone numbers and email addresses. Make must create individual outreach records for these contact points while keeping everything connected to the same parent Property ID: IOS-000001-P01, IOS-000001-P02, IOS-000001-E01, IOS-000001-E02. There should still be only ONE property record in Close.

CRITICAL RESPONSE LOGIC: If any owner responds positively through SMS, email or cold calling, the system should identify the parent Property ID, update the single Close record to OWNER ENGAGED, identify the verified responding contact, record the response source, stop/suppress remaining cold outreach for that property, update the CRM, and notify me so I can take over the seller conversation. DNC, SMS opt-outs, email unsubscribes and other suppression events must be maintained across the system.

Required experience: Make.com, REST APIs, webhooks, HTTP modules, JSON, CRM integrations, data mapping, unique/external IDs, deduplication/idempotency, error handling, retries, data stores and bidirectional SaaS synchronization.

FIRST DELIVERABLE — do not begin by immediately building Make scenarios. I first want: proposed data architecture/schema, complete field-mapping plan, API/webhook capability assessment, Make.com architecture diagram, and identification of limitations or recommended platform changes.

Initial testing: one property with multiple people, ~6 phone numbers and 5 email addresses, demonstrating one upload -> enrichment -> Close -> multichannel outreach -> response -> Property ID lookup -> OWNER ENGAGED -> suppression -> notification. Then ~100 properties before scaling.

Please begin your proposal with the words "PROPERTY ID".

We are seeking an experienced HubSpot and Shopify integration specialist to build a bi-directional data sync and marketing automation ecosystem. Key Responsibilities & Deliverables
Custom Integration & Data Architecture

Design and implement a sync solution (using Shopify Flow, Webhooks, Make/Zapier, or a custom HubSpot Private App) to bypass native integration limits.

Map Shopify custom product options, line-item properties, and metafields to custom properties on HubSpot Deals/Line Items.

Ensure clean data handling to prevent duplicate contact creation or corrupted deal pipelines.

Automated HubSpot Workflows & Personalization

Build post-purchase, upsell, and re-engagement email sequences that dynamically pull custom product option choices into email tokens.

Set up custom Abandoned Checkout / Cart sequences that reflect specific line-item options selected prior to checkout.

Email Template Setup

Analytics & Custom Reporting

Build custom dashboards in HubSpot tracking revenue, Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), workflow conversion rates, and sales performance by product option variations.

Proven experience integrating Shopify with HubSpot for brands using advanced product options / line-item properties.

Deep familiarity with Shopify Metafields, Liquid/API payloads, and HubSpot Custom Objects / Line Item APIs.

Hands-on expertise with middleware (Make, Zapier) or serverless webhook/API implementations.

HubSpot Certified (Inbound Marketing / Workflows / Reporting preferred).

Demonstrated ability to test edge cases before deploying to a live production environment.

GoHighLevel Expert Needed — Dental/Orthodontic CRM, Automation & Patient Tracking 

We are a multi-location dental and orthodontic practice in South Florida looking for an experienced GoHighLevel (GHL) expert to properly configure and optimize our CRM, patient lead tracking, automation, attribution, and follow-up systems.

We have 3 locations:

Pembroke Pines Boynton Beach Royal Palm Beach 

We provide both general dentistry and orthodontics, including Invisalign and braces.

This is NOT simply a request to install a generic GHL snapshot. We want someone who understands how to build a complete patient acquisition and conversion system that allows us to track a lead from the original advertising source all the way through becoming an actual patient.

Primary Goal 

We want to be able to track:

Google Ads / Meta Ads / Website / Phone Call → Lead → Contacted → Appointment Scheduled → Confirmed → Showed → Became Patient → Treatment Started / Revenue

We need to know which campaigns, locations, and lead sources are actually producing patients—not just phone calls or form submissions.

Scope of Work 1. Multi-Location CRM Setup 

Configure GoHighLevel appropriately for our three locations.

We need to distinguish between:

Pembroke Pines Boynton Beach Royal Palm Beach General Dental Orthodontics Invisalign Braces Other major services where appropriate 

The architecture should be scalable and easy for our staff to use.

2. Patient Pipeline 

Create appropriate pipelines/stages such as:

New Lead
→ Attempted Contact
→ Contacted
→ Appointment Scheduled
→ Confirmed
→ Showed
→ No Show
→ Rescheduled
→ Treatment Presented
→ Became Patient
→ Treatment Started

We are open to recommendations from someone with proven dental CRM experience.

3. Phone Call Tracking 

A large percentage of our new patients call the office.

We need to properly track:

Incoming calls Original advertising source Campaign Location Call outcome Whether an appointment was scheduled Whether the patient showed Whether the caller ultimately became a patient 

Calls that do NOT result in an appointment should automatically enter an appropriate follow-up process.

4. Google Ads Tracking & Offline Conversions 

This is extremely important.

We need someone who understands Google Ads offline conversion tracking / enhanced conversions for leads, not simply GHL automation.

We want qualified conversion events sent back to Google when appropriate, such as:

Appointment scheduled Appointment showed Became patient Treatment started 

The objective is to help Google Ads optimize toward patients who actually convert rather than simply generating phone calls or form submissions.

Please explain your previous experience implementing this.

5. Meta/Facebook Lead Tracking 

Properly connect and track leads originating from Meta/Facebook campaigns where applicable.

We want the original source retained throughout the patient's journey.

6. Automated Follow-Up 

Build SMS/email workflows for situations including:

New leads Missed calls Caller did not schedule Form lead did not schedule Appointment reminders Appointment confirmation No-shows Cancelled appointments Unresponsive leads Treatment follow-up Recall/reactivation Review requests 

The system should prevent patients from receiving inappropriate messages after their status changes.

7. Recall & Patient Reactivation 

We want the ability to create campaigns for existing patients who are due or overdue for:

Hygiene/recall Unscheduled treatment Orthodontic consultations Other appropriate reactivation campaigns 

Experience with dental recall systems is highly desirable.

8. Practice Management System Integration 

We want to discuss integration between GoHighLevel and our dental practice-management system.

The goal is to avoid unnecessary duplicate data entry and, where technically possible, allow important patient status changes to update our marketing/CRM workflows.

Experience integrating GHL with dental PMS systems is a major advantage.

Please tell us which dental PMS systems you have previously integrated.

9. Dashboard & Reporting 

We want simple reporting by location and lead source showing metrics such as:

Leads Phone calls Appointments scheduled Show rate No-show rate Became patients Lead-to-appointment conversion rate Appointment-to-patient conversion rate Overall lead-to-patient conversion rate Advertising source/campaign Revenue attribution where technically feasible 

We should be able to compare our three locations.

10. AI / Future Automation 

We may eventually implement AI for:

Answering inbound calls After-hours calls Missed-call recovery Scheduling patients Outbound recall calls Reactivation campaigns Appointment confirmation 

The initial GHL architecture should therefore be designed so AI calling can be added later without rebuilding the entire CRM.

HIPAA / Security 

Because this is a dental practice, experience working with HIPAA-sensitive environments is important.

You should understand the limitations of marketing CRM systems when handling PHI and be able to explain how you would structure the system appropriately.

Ownership 

All workflows, pipelines, automations, integrations, phone numbers where appropriate, tracking configurations, documentation, and other work must be built within accounts that we own and control.

We do not want our business dependent upon an agency-owned CRM account.

Who We're Looking For 

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

Strong GoHighLevel experience Dental or medical GHL experience Multi-location business experience Google Ads offline conversion experience Call tracking experience API/webhook experience Zapier, Make or n8n experience Dental PMS integration experience Twilio/phone/SMS experience Meta integration experience Strong reporting/dashboard experience IMPORTANT — Please Answer These Questions 

Please do NOT send a generic proposal.

In your response, answer the following:

How many dental practices have you personally configured in GoHighLevel?

Can you show us a dental GHL system or similar healthcare system you personally built?

How would you structure GHL for 3 locations offering both general dentistry and orthodontics?

Explain how you would track a patient from a Google Ads click or phone call all the way through becoming an actual patient.

Have you personally implemented Google Ads offline conversions or enhanced conversions for leads from GoHighLevel? Please describe the implementation.

How would you handle someone who calls the office but does NOT schedule an appointment?

Which dental practice-management systems have you integrated with GHL?

How would you prevent duplicate patient/contact records?

Have you built recall/reactivation campaigns for dental practices?

Have you implemented AI inbound or outbound phone agents with GHL?

How would you handle HIPAA/PHI considerations?

Will the entire system be built inside accounts that we own and control?

What would you charge as a fixed project price for this implementation?

Approximately how long would implementation and testing take?

Project Structure 

We prefer a fixed-price project with milestones rather than an unlimited hourly engagement.

Potential milestones could include:

Milestone 1: System architecture, account configuration and pipelines

Milestone 2: Lead sources, call tracking and Google/Meta attribution

Milestone 3: Workflows, appointment follow-up, no-show recovery and recall/reactivation

Milestone 4: PMS/integration work and offline conversion tracking

Milestone 5: Dashboard, testing, documentation and staff training

Please provide examples of relevant work and explain specifically how you would approach our project.

We are looking for someone who can build a long-term system—not simply install a generic snapshot.
